= Unresolved cross-reference coverage

Typst fails a whole compilation on a link to a label no element defines, so an
unresolved target renders as text alone.

See <<no-such-id>> and <<no-such-id,explicit text>>.

A reference whose target's reference text holds a reference of its own resolves
one level, then falls back to `[id]`.
